description: highly detailed crisp pixel art scene, fine pixel detail: a small mysterious figure in a dark navy hooded cloak, its face a glowing ice-blue light, glowing ice-blue hands, sitting cross-legged in calm meditation on the grass, facing the viewer, its hands resting on its knees, a soft glowing ice-blue aura around the figure and small motes of light slowly rising from it, in the middle of a ring of old mossy standing stones in a misty forest glade at dusk, the stones in front low enough not to hide the figure, dark spruce trees behind, a soft purple and amber dusk sky, low mist over the grass, calm and mystical Slavic forest fantasy, the whole figure and the whole stone ring inside the frame

references.usage: the same small hooded figure: its dark navy cloak, its glowing ice-blue face and hands, its size in the frame and the fine pixel style; only the pose and the place are new
